abilities.name: Impetuous Fervour
abilities.text: When you Charge you reduce the Multi-Attack penalty by 2.

note: No Influence printed. Wargear prints "Novitiate Armour and Vestments" (split: rr2-novitiate-armour, and Vestments as Core Clothing, like Sororitas Vestments elsewhere) and "a copy of Rule of the Sororitas". name: Palatine

abilities.name: Fury of the Righteous
abilities.text:
You have 1 Faith.
You can spend 1 Faith at any time to activate Fury of the Righteous until the start of your next Turn. While Fury of the Righteous is active, any allies with the ADEPTUS MINISTORUM Keyword within 6m of you gain +Rank bonus dice to melee attack Tests.

note: No Influence printed. Print error: ATTRIBUTES prints "Intellect" with no rating; left out. The Suggested Attributes XP (30) is exactly Int 3 + Fel 4 above the printed ratings, consistent with Int at 1. Suggested talents are RR2 Faith Talents (pp.68–70). XP as printed; ratings + (Tier − 1) × 10 = 173.

name: Corpuscarii Electro-Priest
note: RR2 prints a base ELECTRO-PRIEST block (XP 62) and two option blocks (+10 XP each; "Electro-Priest Schism: You are either a Corpuscarii Electro-Priest or a Fulgrite Electro-Priest. Choose from the options below."); this record is the base plus the Corpuscarii option, XP 62 + 10 = 72. XP as printed (base + option); ratings + (Tier − 1) × 10 = 62, the base block's printed XP. No Influence or Suggested Talents printed. KEYWORDS print only IMPERIUM, ADEPTUS MECHANICUS (no [FORGE WORLD]). Replaces Apocrypha's Corpuscarius Electro-Priest (Apocrypha p.110), a different homebrew build of the same archetype; same id kept. Robes linked to Clothing, as Core's Ministorum Robes.
